vector_memory.semantic_summary: AuthInterceptor is an Angular HttpInterceptor responsible for securing API communications by automatically injecting the user's authentication token into every outgoing request via the Authorization: Bearer header. It functions as a critical middleware layer within the HTTP client pipeline. A key responsibility is handling 401 Unauthorized responses by clearing the local session and redirecting the user to the login page.
